scope: Local single-thread CPU engineering measurements; no CUDA throughput or playing-strength claim.

public_events.claim: CPU public-event component only; no PPO/GPU/strength claim

page_pool.scope: page allocation only; no encoder, PPO or playing-strength measurement

gradients.scope: actor gradient clipping and encoder metrics only; not full PPO
gradients.parity: exact norms, encoder squared norms and clipped gradients

complete_ppo.protocol: Two sequential A B B A blocks for each of dense, paged, snapshots; A=original revision, B=candidate. Same script file, matching extensions, no concurrent tests/timing. Each process executes four updates; first excluded as warmup.
complete_ppo.metric: Ratio of candidate and baseline median decisions per external wall second (four trials per arm per case). Full update includes collection, learning and update logging; startup, checkpoints and process teardown excluded.

python.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 python -m pytest -q tests -n 2 --dist=worksteal
python.note: Localhost sockets enabled for CPU Gloo distributed tests; CUDA and optional fixture/dependency cases remain skipped.

validation.sanitizers: Not run locally; the existing Linux CI workflow includes ASan/UBSan tests and fuzzing.
validation.baseline_environment_note: Initial full-suite comparison was blocked only by five socket-denied DDP cases in the sandbox; rerunning the baseline DDP suite with localhost sockets enabled passed all 11 tests.
